summary.text: GUDMESTAD TRANSPORT AS is a private limited company registered in Sandnes, founded 2000-12-14. Gudmestad Transport AS is a transport company that also invests in other companies with the same purpose and in anything connected to this. It was previously named ARNE GUDMESTAD TRANSPORT AS until 2008-05-13. Its main industry code is 49.410: freight transport by road. The register shows 24 employees and 1 registered workplace. In its 2025 accounts, total operating income was 63 472 297 NOK and the annual result was -308 080 NOK; operating income was up from 57 550 701 NOK in 2024. The annual result rose from -549 104 NOK in 2024 to -308 080 NOK in 2025. Equity fell from 10 283 951 NOK in 2024 to 9 975 871 NOK in 2025. Its verified website is gudmestad-transport.no, which links to its Facebook, Instagram profiles. It holds a Legal Entity Identifier (549300FFQHRSTCUH6485). The registered employee count went from 28 on 2025-12-13 to 24 on 2026-09-15. Recent changes in the register: share capital set to 30 000 on 2026-04-11.
